tools.name: get_brand_kit
tools.description: Reads a business's public website and returns its name, a colour palette (with where each colour was found; colours read from the logo are the most reliable, and website-builder default colours are filtered out), logo and icon image URLs, a hero image, a guess at the type of business, and a suggeste

tools.name: list_design_options
tools.description: Lists what a Leal loyalty card can look like: stamp icons, preset strip photos, limits, and how the pass is laid out on Apple and Google Wallet. Works without a Leal account.

tools.name: preview_card_designs
tools.description: Renders one to four loyalty card designs as Apple Wallet and Google Wallet passes so the person can compare them and pick one. Checks each design against Leal's rules and flags hard-to-read colour combinations. Returns a shareable preview link per design. Works without a Leal account; nothing is sav

tools.name: list_stores
tools.description: Lists the Leal stores this login can manage, with each store's id, plan and how far through setup it is, and the agencies it can add new stores to with create_store.

tools.name: get_store_setup
tools.description: Shows a store's setup checklist (store details, card, poster, first customer, staff app), plan limits and usage, and its cards with rewards, locations and posters.

tools.name: list_cards
tools.description: Lists a store's loyalty cards with their rewards.

tools.name: get_card
tools.description: Shows a saved loyalty card's design and rewards, with an Apple and Google Wallet preview.

tools.name: create_store
tools.description: Adds a new, empty store to the login's agency, with its own cards, posters and locations: for a client, a second business, or a demo to show a prospect. Then set it up with create_card, create_poster and create_location using the returned store_id. Don't use this to set up a store the login already

tools.name: update_store
tools.description: Sets a store's public name and logos, which Leal uses on cards, posters and signup pages. Logos are fetched from public image URLs (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF or SVG). Replaces the current values.

tools.name: create_card
tools.description: Saves a loyalty card design and its rewards to a Leal store, ready for customers to add to Apple Wallet or Google Wallet. Takes the same design fields as preview_card_designs. Logos and strip photos are fetched from their URLs; if the store has no logo yet, the card's logo becomes the store logo. Ne

tools.name: update_card
tools.description: Changes a saved card's design. Only the fields passed change; the rest stay as they are. Customers' passes in Apple Wallet and Google Wallet update automatically.

tools.name: create_reward
tools.description: Adds a reward that customers can redeem with stamps from a card, e.g. a free coffee at 10 stamps.

tools.name: update_reward
tools.description: Changes a reward's name, stamps needed or description, or turns it off. Only the fields passed change.

tools.name: create_location
tools.description: Adds a physical location to a store. The address is geocoded so wallet passes can remind customers nearby.

tools.name: create_poster
tools.description: Creates a printable poster with a QR code for a card. Customers scan it, fill in a short form on a public Leal signup page, and add the card to their wallet. Returns the signup link and a print link. Colours default to the card's.
